summary: The PR addresses the issue of ignoring the `formats` argument when writing tables to HTML format, but there are some concerns regarding test coverage and potential impacts on existing behavior.

issues.description: There are no new tests added to verify the functionality of the `formats` argument with HTML output. While the existing tests pass, additional tests should be included to ensure the fix works as expected.

Modifying the `col.info.format` directly may affect how other parts of the code handle these columns, especially if they rely on the original format. This change should be carefully evaluated to ensure it does not introduce unintended side effects.
